programs.source:
gcd =: 4 : 0
  a =. x
  b =. y
  while. b ~: 0 do.
    remainder =. b|a
    a =. b
    b =. remainder
  end.
  a
)
main =: 3 : 0
  for_pair. 5 2$48 180 1071 462 7 91 13 97 36288 98280 do.
    'a b' =. pair
    divisor =. a gcd b
    multiple =. (a%divisor)*b
    label =. '(', (":a), ', ', (":b), ') = '
    smoutput 'gcd', label, (":divisor), ', lcm', label, (, '0' 8!:2 multiple)
  end.
)
main ''
